lines.en: Hey, if you're looking for a place,
I just heard in the elevator this morning
that a woman in my building died.
Well, I don't know, but how-- how great would that be, huh?
I could help take care of the baby.
I could come over whenever I want, with your permission.
Wow, that really would be great.
I mean, if she just died this morning, out of respect.
And I'm Rachel, an admirer of the building.
I-- I heard about Mrs. Verhoeven passing away,
and I'm so sorry for your loss.
It looked like we were going to lose her this morning,
but she's a tough old bird.
Uh, yeah, she and I would talk all the time in the laundry room.
You know, I would, but it's just too painful.
Do you think-- could you tell me,
is she hanging in in a-- in a one bedroom or a two?
